about: Objects taught to Lucius beyond the tutorials, with the techniques it learned. Replay with `lucius teach course courses/objects`; then `lucius make "a sword"` rebuilds one without a model.

lessons.note: From a reference picture (the Mario mushroom in a tutorial thumbnail): half UV sphere cap with the rim tucked under, subdivided; spots painted by a dots pattern (Voronoi circles) in pale cyan; bevelled barrel stem; glossy black eyes with highlights; green ground, warm background. Spot layout is procedural, not the exact placement of the reference.

Cylinder body with the nose extruded and scaled to a point in steps, tail inset with a cone nozzle, one fin shaped by moving vertices then duplicated at 120 and 240 degrees, torus porthole with glowing glass, red band on loop-cut faces.

Brass holder made the plate's way (inset dish, extruded thickness), a wax cylinder with an inset melted top and bevelled rim, a wick, a teardrop flame shaped with proportional editing, emission and a warm point light.

Box walls with a loop-cut ridge pulled up into a gable; loop cuts make a door and two windows (inset, pushed in, own materials, glowing); the roof faces separated as a copy, scaled out for eaves and solidified; chimney.
Tapered 8-sided trunk with flared roots, three Clouds-displaced icospheres as a lumpy crown in two greens, a grass mound; flat shaded low-poly look.
Turned like the mug: a filled circle extruded and scaled into body, shoulder, neck and lip; open mouth and a punt; loop cuts for a label band given its own material; green transmissive glass.
Bistro table: bevelled round oak top, a black column flared at both ends, four sloping feet from one foot mirrored on X and Y.

Articulated desk lamp: bevelled base, two steel arms with a ball joint, an open cone shade with Solidify, glowing bulb and a warm spot throwing a pool of light on the floor. Arm proportions a little simple.
Slatted wooden chair built from bevelled boxes, one leg mirrored per pair, an array of slats, noise-grain wood; reads clearly as a dining chair from the three-quarter shot.

Longsword at real size from the course's techniques (cube blade with a centre loop cut, extruded and scaled tip, edges scaled thin for a diamond section, bevel modifier; guard with extruded upswept ends, bevel+subsurf; array of torus rings as the grip wrap; flattened sphere pommel), metal/gold/leather materials, three-point studio light, portrait camera. Guard a little blocky.
